{{Otheruses|krill}}
'''Krill''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of zooplankton that were found on [[Water/Legends|watery]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] like [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. One of their main predators were [[Aiwha/Legends|Aiwhas]].
